name: Apple Notes PKM Helper
notes: Expected identity of the one process allowed to send Apple Events to Notes. apple-notes-pkm.py verifies an installed helper's code signature against bundle_id + signing_common_name before use, and reconcile-apple-notes-helper.sh builds/signs/installs against the same. signing_common_name is the Common Name of the user-owned code-signing certificate the helper must be signed with; a stable (non-ad-hoc) identity is required so TCC's grant survives rebuilds. No binary and no signing secret is committed.
